comment: The single EN/HU text table of MacVPN. The key is the English text (also the en value); scope core = core/root messages (was L10n.swift), app = UI texts (was Localizable.xcstrings), mvpn = root layer messages (were the msg texts of the bash mvpn / ovpn-dns), platform = messages new in the Rust platform layer. String(format:) specifiers. The key is the macOS wording. Optional per entry: only = the OSes whose code paths show the text (e.g. ["macos"]; no variant needed); variants.<os> (windows or linux) = {en, hu}, the text on that OS, with the same format specifiers as the base. On an OS whose product is not MacVPN, MacVPN in the resolved text becomes the product name (WinVPN), except in a text whose only list leaves that OS out. On macOS every text is the base text. See docs/architecture.md.
